opening: I have pain in my lower back.
My doctor sent me here because I was found to be anemic.
I was also told my platelet count is low.
It came on gradually, about seven months ago.
The breathlessness, tiredness and palpitations started about four months ago.
I get short of breath when I exert myself.
I've been having palpitations; I can feel my heart beating.

opening.text: I have pain in my lower back, which came on gradually about seven months ago. My doctor sent me here because I was found to be anemic, and I was also told my platelet count is low. About four months ago, I started getting short of breath when I exert myself, feeling tired, and having palpitations where I can feel my heart beating.
